name: convention-json-configuration-document
description: The document of a JSON configuration file is its default export, so an applied convention row reads its properties there as it reads a module's default export: the test runner the Stryker configuration selects by its short name is used, and the runner it does not select is reported. The fixture assumes the analyzer carries a row named stryker for the package @stryker-mutator/core whose range holds the installed version and which reads testRunner from stryker.config.json as the short name of the package @stryker-mutator/{}-runner.
